# AgentOre v0.0.2

AgentOre v0.0.2 connects the macOS menu bar application to the verified Base Mainnet deployment.

## Included

- universal macOS application for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs;
- Base Mainnet contract `0xcd5aB54841e0571671CbFBf15328097D6143De76` configured by default;
- automatic migration of legacy configurations with no contract address;
- menu display of the active contract;
- Base Mainnet deployment and verification tooling.

## Install

1. Download `AgentOre-v0.0.2-macos-universal.zip` and its `.sha256` file.
2. Verify the SHA-256 checksum.
3. Unzip and move `AgentOre.app` to `/Applications`.

The app requires macOS 14 or newer. This release is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized.

AgentOre usage values remain self-reported. The deployed contract has not been professionally audited and is not suitable for assets with monetary value.
